assertion.rationale: F4: the layer-06 and layer-07 job summaries and uploaded artifacts publish keyVaultUri, sqlServerFqdn, costExportStorageResourceId, lawCustomerId and the subscription ID embedded in every resource ID to a public, unauthenticated surface — estate configuration that CLAUDE.md's own hard rule 5 requires to live only in GitHub environment variables. That data is confidential estate configuration and it is not being protected at rest in its committed/published form.

recommendation: Stop cat-ing the full manifest into $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY; summarise only non-sensitive selected keys. Drop the artifact upload of the raw manifest entirely.
